description: project-guardrails hooks: (1) SessionStart injects the repo's declared context from <repo>/.agents/guardrails.json (fallback .zcode/); (2) SessionStart (separate entry, independent failure domain) pushes the handoff ledger index + doc-size budget into context — the `entrypoints` feature; (3) PreToolUse enforces the declared tool rules. matcher is intentionally omitted on PreToolUse so rules can target any tool; every script exits immediately when its config file is absent.
